main_text.l: Quoniam Galenus uarijs in locis ani-
circo complures nō indocti medici ipsum
rum longe aliter sentimus. Tametsi enim
num est organum, nihil tamen per se agit,
nec quoq; principes animæ actiones, puta
potest. Est enim duntaxat commune agen-
cerebrum est. Idcirco ut ad ratiocinandum,
ritu utitur, qui harum actionum proprium
organum illustrat, agendique uim ipsi con-
fert. Sic ad sentiendum alijs proprijs instru-
mentis eodem spiritu illustratis, ac ui sen-

page.notes: The catchword "tiendi" is the fragment of the word "sentiendi" carried over to the next page. The heading's title words are set in spaced capitals and small type; they are transcribed as one heading with the exercise number. Long s has been rendered as a plain s throughout. The running head is printed in small capitals with a page number at the top left.
